message.fl_zone_arts.tesla.not_start_poi: This is point #%1$s. Right-click the start point again to close the route.
message.fl_zone_arts.tesla.other_route: That point belongs to another route — you are building your own.
message.fl_zone_arts.tesla.route_info: Route #%1$s: %2$s point(s), starts at %3$s. Left-click one of its points to remove it with its anomaly.
message.fl_zone_arts.tesla.draft_info: Unfinished route by %1$s, starts at %2$s. Left-click one of its points to remove it.
message.fl_zone_arts.tesla.route_complet: Route #%1$s completed: %2$s point(s). The anomaly appears at %3$s.
message.fl_zone_arts.tesla.spawn_failed: Route #%1$s saved, but the anomaly could not be created.
message.fl_zone_arts.tesla.route_removed: Route #%1$s removed together with its anomaly.
message.fl_zone_arts.tesla.draft_removed: Your unfinished route was removed by %1$s.
message.fl_zone_arts.tesla.draft_reset_d: Unfinished route (start %1$s) was reset because you changed dimension.
message.fl_zone_arts.anomaly.inside_othe: Anomalies are placed on blocks only, not inside another anomaly
message.fl_zone_arts.tesla.other_kind: You are building a route for this anomaly — finish or cancel it before starting another.
tooltip.fl_zone_arts.tuner.controls.2: Target: an anomaly zone or a route point.
item.fl_zone_arts.electra_placer.desc.0: Shocks everyone who enters the zone,
item.fl_zone_arts.zharka_placer.desc.0: Burns everyone in the zone, may set them on fire.
item.fl_zone_arts.zharka_placer.desc.1: Melts ice and snow, dries water,
item.fl_zone_arts.razlom_placer.desc.0: Burning cracks with a flame above them.
item.fl_zone_arts.tesla_placer.desc.0: Route for a Tesla, a ball lightning
item.fl_zone_arts.tesla_placer.desc.2: Right-click a block: add a point,
item.fl_zone_arts.tesla_placer.desc.3: right-click the first point: close the route.
item.fl_zone_arts.tesla_placer.desc.4: Left-click a point: remove it or the route.
item.fl_zone_arts.comet_placer.desc.0: Route for a Comet, a fireball
item.fl_zone_arts.comet_placer.desc.2: Right-click a block: add a point,
item.fl_zone_arts.comet_placer.desc.3: right-click the first point: close the route.
item.fl_zone_arts.comet_placer.desc.4: Left-click a point: remove it or the route.
item.fl_zone_arts.targeting_tuner.desc.0: How far a Tesla or Comet
item.fl_zone_arts.cold_comet_placer.desc: Route for a Cold Comet, a soul-fire ball
Right-click a block: add a point,
right-click the first point: close the route.
Left-click a point: remove it or the route.
item.fl_zone_arts.cold_razlom_placer.des: Soul-fire cracks with a flame above them.
death.attack.fl_zone_arts.anomaly_gravit: %1$s was torn apart by a gravitational anomaly
death.attack.fl_zone_arts.anomaly_impact: %1$s was flung into a wall by an anomaly
item.fl_zone_arts.plesh_placer.desc.0: Pulls everything around to its center,
item.fl_zone_arts.plesh_placer.desc.1: spins it and flings it up and away.
item.fl_zone_arts.voronka_placer.desc.0: Pulls everything in and tears it apart:
item.fl_zone_arts.voronka_placer.desc.1: damage, loot in the core destroyed.
item.fl_zone_arts.karusel_placer.desc.0: A whirlwind: pulls to its axis and spins.
item.fl_zone_arts.karusel_placer.desc.1: Whoever stays near the center gets hurt.
item.fl_zone_arts.podushka_placer.desc.0: Harmless: breaks a fall and bounces up.
item.fl_zone_arts.chem_comet_placer.desc: Route for a Chemical Comet — a clot
of yellow-green gas. On impact it bursts
into a poisonous cloud creeping over the ground.
Right-click a block — add a point,
right-click the first point — close the route.
Left-click a point — remove it or the route.
item.fl_zone_arts.gravi_placer.desc.0: Route for a Gravi — an invisible anomaly
item.fl_zone_arts.gravi_placer.desc.1: passing through everything. Only a chain
item.fl_zone_arts.gravi_placer.desc.2: of gravitational pops around gives it away.
item.fl_zone_arts.gravi_placer.desc.3: Right-click a block — add a point,
item.fl_zone_arts.gravi_placer.desc.4: right-click the first point — close the route.
item.fl_zone_arts.gravi_placer.desc.5: Left-click a point — remove it or the route.
item.fl_zone_arts.lift_placer.desc.0: A nearly invisible zone without weight:
item.fl_zone_arts.lift_placer.desc.1: everything floats, bogs down in the air
item.fl_zone_arts.lift_placer.desc.2: and in time is pushed out to the edge (force — Speed).
death.attack.fl_zone_arts.anomaly_chemic: %1$s was eaten away by a chemical anomaly
item.fl_zone_arts.amoeba_placer.desc.0: A puddle of jelly. Sensing life it swells,
item.fl_zone_arts.amoeba_placer.desc.1: lifts off the ground and bursts into a toxic
item.fl_zone_arts.amoeba_placer.desc.2: cloud. Touching it while swollen burns.
block.fl_zone_arts.pukh.desc.0: A plant-like anomaly. Goes on a ceiling
block.fl_zone_arts.pukh.desc.1: (hangs like a beard) or a wall (like a creeper).
block.fl_zone_arts.pukh.desc.2: Its strands burn, and it shoots a puff of
block.fl_zone_arts.pukh.desc.3: burning spores at anything coming near fast.
item.fl_zone_arts.kisel_placer.desc.0: A seething puddle of bright green slime.
item.fl_zone_arts.kisel_placer.desc.1: Whatever gets in hisses and is eaten away
item.fl_zone_arts.kisel_placer.desc.2: by acid: items, projectiles, legs and boots.
item.fl_zone_arts.acid_fog_placer.desc.0: A dense greenish haze over the ground, barely
item.fl_zone_arts.acid_fog_placer.desc.1: visible by day. Burns slowly, and jets of acid
item.fl_zone_arts.acid_fog_placer.desc.2: vapour and spray shoot up out of it.
item.fl_zone_arts.tryasina_placer.desc.0: Ground like any other — only too clean and
item.fl_zone_arts.tryasina_placer.desc.1: silent. Whoever walks out from the edge slowly
item.fl_zone_arts.tryasina_placer.desc.2: sinks into the blocks; head under — chokes.
item.fl_zone_arts.tryasina_placer.desc.3: Right-click a block — it becomes the surface,
item.fl_zone_arts.dymka_placer.desc.0: A faint mist. Inside one sees a few metres,
item.fl_zone_arts.dymka_placer.desc.1: sounds are dull and bent, and something is
item.fl_zone_arts.sumrak_placer.desc.0: Churning darkness swallowing light and sound:
item.fl_zone_arts.sumrak_placer.desc.1: nothing inside is seen or heard, and from
item.fl_zone_arts.psi_zone_placer.desc.0: Gives itself away in no way. Mobs leave it;
item.fl_zone_arts.psi_zone_placer.desc.1: players are slowed, hear a hum and whispers,
item.fl_zone_arts.psi_zone_placer.desc.2: their sight swims and splits. No damage.
item.fl_zone_arts.poppy_field_placer.des: Thick poppies and clouds of petals. The pollen
brings micro-sleeps — eyes close, the legs
wander off. Past the limit — asleep for good.
item.fl_zone_arts.rust_placer.desc.0: Everything is overgrown with rusty moss. Steps
item.fl_zone_arts.rust_placer.desc.1: raise caustic dust; now and then a patch goes
item.fl_zone_arts.rust_placer.desc.2: red-hot — step on it, it sticks. Snow cools it.
block.fl_zone_arts.ezhik.desc.0: Goes on any face of a block: the surface
block.fl_zone_arts.ezhik.desc.1: swells into lumps and spikes of the same block
death.attack.fl_zone_arts.anomaly_sleep: %1$s fell asleep in a poppy field and never woke
